name: Platform-cloudflare-kv facade
purpose: The single project-side module that dereferences the Cloudflare Workers KV binding (env.<binding>), exposes narrow named domain verbs (get, getWithMetadata, put, delete, list) to consumer code, and emits structured lifecycle events to the event sink (TAC-3203). Consumers never touch the raw binding outside this module; the facade is the one place the vendor surface lives. The KV driver reference is opaque at this boundary so a future adapter (a different vendor, an in-memory driver for tests) slots in without a facade re-shape.
responsibilities: Open the facade on boot against the elicited KV binding via a bounded list(limit:1) ready-check; hold no other reference to the KV vendor surface; export no symbol that leaks the raw binding (AC-31101-1, AC-31102-1).
Expose named domain verbs (get, getWithMetadata, put, delete, list) as returned methods on the factory result; refuse a raw-binding passthrough on the public surface (AC-31101-1).
Emit facadeReady exactly once per facade instance on the injected event sink (AC-31101-1); serialise pre-ready operations behind the ready-check.
Emit kvHit / kvMiss / kvWrite per operation, all metadata-only per TAC-3203 (AC-31107-1, AC-31108-1).

Apply the elicited keyPrefix (a per-app namespace disambiguator) transparently on every operation so the domain code sees prefix-free keys and the storage layer sees fully qualified keys (elicited answer per ADR-3203).
internalStructure: One module exporting a createKvFacade({ binding, eventSink, keyPrefix?, defaultCacheTtl? }) factory returning a KvFacade whose methods are the named domain verbs. The binding dereference lives at the top of this module; the factory captures the binding, wires the sink, and hands back closures. Consumers call the facade methods for the process lifetime; the raw binding never crosses the module boundary.
